sylvia: Heads up: after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak we see tail latency spikes on some Llama3 13B chat workloads. Initial trace:

miguel: seeing +30-40% p99 on long-chat templates, particularly when using prefix padding and RMSNorm+SiLU variants.

tj: probable KV alignment issue with prefix padding. Can you paste a microprofile?

sylvia: Sure — here's a trimmed profile (local instrument):
```
profile: kernel_selector=auto -> chose fallback kernel 'matmul_slow' at step 37
kv_cache_miss_rate: 0.12
kv_hotloop_evictions: 47
p99_latency_ms: 210 -> 300
seq_len=2048 prefix=512 head_dim=128 hidden=5120 rope_theta=1000
rmsnorm_path=fast_silu_quant
```

benchbot: auto-bench (2026-03-17T21:12Z): +32% p99 vs baseline on chat-template long-history test (seeded).

miguel: Hypothesis: the selector's cost model didn't account for RoPE frequency shifts (rope_theta) for Llama3 variants; when prefixpad changes the effective seq distrib, kv stride misaligns and kernel fallback triggers. Also interaction with RMSNorm+SiLU quant path might make the 'fast' kernel inapplicable.

sylvia: Repro steps (local docker):
```
./run_bench --model llm-llama3-13b --seq 2048 --prefix 512 --batch 1 --kernel-selector auto --rmsnorm si lu
```
(typo in flag above: --rmsnorm si lu) — correct: --rmsnorm silu
```
./run_bench --model llm-llama3-13b --seq 2048 --prefix 512 --batch 1 --kernel-selector auto --rmsnorm silu
```

tj: Can we try pinning the selector to the pre-change heuristic?

sylvia: Pushed quick patch to pin selector in canary: https://git.internal/r/inference/commit/9f2a... (canary id: canary-118)

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary canary-118 rolled to us-west-2 (subset: 20%)

sylvia: Canary metrics: p99 returned to baseline within 10 minutes. Looks like selector change is culprit. Next steps: modify cost model to include rope_theta and head_dim alignment, and add a gating rule for RMSNorm+SiLU mixed-precision path. Assigning @miguel to prototype new heuristic.

miguel: I'll try a conservative heuristic: if head_dim % 64 == 0 and rope_theta < 1500 then prefer kernel 'matmul_fast_prefetch'; also add a check to avoid the SiLU quant path known to mismatch. Will send PR with microbench results.

sylvia: Also need unit test: chat-template prefix pad + KV hotloop + mixed-precision path. Put it under tests/perf/kv_align.

benchbot: Created perf ticket INF-3427: "LLama3 selector change -> p99 regression with prefix pad + RMSNorm+SiLU" https://tracker.internal/INF-3427

tj: Great. After Miguel's PR, let's run full-scale canary and update rollout docs. :thumbsup:

miguel: On it — tracking progress in INF-3427. Thanks everyone.
